summary: Horizontal compass strip at the top of the screen, with pins on it. The kit follows the player's view and writes the heading as one class; pins sit at their bearing relative to it.

panels.doc: The compass. Author it with class `hidden`. Style = accent of the caret and of the north. `at-*` is CompassOptions.Placement: `at-hud` under the game's team bar (default), `at-top` against the top edge, `at-bottom` above the inventory, `at-tl` under the radar, `at-tr` under the kill feed, `at-right` on the right edge, centred, `at-band` in the band of a match bar (MatchOptions.Band).

The strip of ticks and letters. `hd-N` puts the heading 2.5*N-90 degrees under the caret (N of 0..216: the strip runs from -180 to 540 degrees so the kit can follow a turn past north without sliding back).

A pin. Author it `hidden`. `rel-N` places it 2.5*N-90 degrees from the caret (N of 0..72); beyond 90 degrees it gets `edge-l` or `edge-r` instead, at that edge. `kind-<name>` is its shape (CompassNames), `style-*` its colour.
Label of the pin's distance, `empty` when there is none.
